description: Lockheed Martin Corporation is a global aerospace and defense technology company that builds and sustains the solutions America and its allies need to deter conflict and advance national security and scientific exploration objectives, with its four business areas Aeronautics, Missiles and Fire Control, Rotary and Mission Systems, and Space working as one company offering integrated solutions, at scale, across all warfighting domains, and its defense, space, intelligence, homeland security, information technology and cybersecurity capabilities serving U.S. and international customers in defense, civil and commercial applications, with its principal customers being agencies of the U.S. Government and allies. It is rapidly transforming its business to meet increased demand, expanding production capacity to continue delivering at scale and harnessing leading-edge technologies like artificial intelligence and autonomy.
